title: The container platform must require users to reauthenticate when organization-defined circumstances or situations require reauthentication.
check_content:
Review documentation and configuration to determine if the container platform requires a user to reauthenticate when organization-defined circumstances or situations are met. 

If the container platform does not meet this requirement, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the container platform to require a user to reauthenticate when organization-defined circumstances or situations are met.
